provenance: Scripted Operator uses the real operator web form and the same Chromium Surface Adapter used by Replay. No person at a keyboard is claimed. Browser capture options are instrumented; no application, Policy, Session or Replay behavior is replaced.
privacy: Synthetic fixture values only. Video pixels are unredacted. No audio or desktop capture. Operator token supplied through request headers and omitted from receipts.

marks.text: Replay paused at the supervisor hold. The operator request includes the stopping context.
The Operator owns the original Session. Automation cannot act.
A competing Replay was refused with control_lost.
The Operator enters synthetic supervisor values in the same application Session.
Authorize releases the hold. Both balances are now visible.
The request records observed field changes and the confirmed action. Future runs must ask a person.
Control returns to automation. Replay verifies the account screen before extracting balances.
Verified success: available 2730.11 USD; current 2905.60 USD. One Session throughout.

owners.by: the run took control back and resumed

steps.intent: Land on the Member Services search screen with an empty search form.
Type the member number into the search panel's own number field.
Submit the search and arrive at the member's record.
Open the account the caller asked for, whichever of them that is.
Read the available balance out of the account panel.
Read the current ledger balance out of the same panel.

composition: Two real browser recordings aligned to page-creation timestamps, at original speed. Added labels and event-derived captions. Final frames held for five seconds to read the verified result. No UI states fabricated.
